Although this dog continues to show appropriate behavior outside of the kennel with positive interactions with staff and volunteers,without intervention, both emotional and physical well-being may continue to decline. Immediate placement is needed with an experienced adopter or New Hope Partner who can provide a calm, supportive home and time for decompression. Placement needed by close of business 8/16/26. 07/06/26 12:49 Updating recommendations.
6/29/2026
Outside for AM cleaning with tense body, tail tucked, ears dropped back, came forward to sniff treat but did not accept, would sniff handlers hand with some tucked wagging tail. Easy leash placement at front of kennel, exited with slow and easy leash pull, stop n go to sniff throughout walk, some hesitation to enter play yard due to neighboring yard being accompanied by another dog in which this dog began pulling towards dog with flagged tail, stiff body, some thrashing on leash when attempting to direct into play yard, dog entered yard when handler knelt down and coaxed over. Shook off with wagging tucked tail once in yard, softened up and became wiggly towards handler, accepted pets all over while leaning into handlers legs, would begin to sniff around yard and explore with neutral soft body, will have wagging tail and come to handler when called over. Jumped onto handler with front paws as handler sat on bench, soft body, soft eyes, wagging tail, accepted pets all over. Towards end of evaluation dog would start to show signs of high arousal due to reactive dogs outside of kennel and dogs being walked passed yard, heavy panting, tense body, flagged tail, runs towards fence line in direction of dogs and begins to low growl/bark, will come to handler if handler kneels down and calls over. Picked up leash and dog had slow walk out of yard, would not walk in direction towards kennel, began thrashing and pulling away. Took alternate route thru inside building and out of exit by CAT GALLERY towards kennel with no issues, slow walk throughout and startled by little dogs in passing kennels. Would not approach kennel unless handler knelt down and coaxed over but when getting close to kennel dog would begin to thrash heavily on leash, pulling away from kennel with stiff body, able to use leash pressure to guide dog into kennel with no issues. Used clip leash for leash retrieval.
6/28/2026
Dog was closed inside for cleaning, curled up on kuranda bed. Looked up when called by handler, began trembling. Handler cracked gate open, presented leash. Dog stood, slowly approached with head low, wagging tail. Easy to leash. Exited kennel, shook off, walked slowly with handler to door, no visible reaction to neighboring dogs. Once outside, dog had slow, loose leash pace, frequent stop and go to sniff intently. Walked to main play yard slowly but without issue. Dog spent several minutes sniffing, moving slowly around yard. Handler sat on bench, gave dog time. Dog got closer to handler, handler began calling dog softly. Dog wagged tail, approached handler, allowed petting, then hopped up to rest front feet in handler's lap. Leaned in for petting. No interest in treats. Hopped down after a moment, continued exploring and intently sniffing yard. Dog had no issue with handler following around yard for a few moments, and would wag tail when handler reached out to pet. Handler returned to bench, dog followed, put front feet into handler's lap and allowed all petting, nuzzling snout into handler's arm. On return, dog walked mostly loose leash. Would not enter kennel wing, pulled back on leash. Handler gave dog a moment to settle, then verbally coaxed and applied light leash pressure. Dog followed handler in. Walked past neighboring dogs, stopped and pulled towards one reactive one. Dog would not enter kennel, pulled back on leash, briefly side-eyeing handler. Handler opened divider, tossed treats, dog would not enter. Dog's body language began tensing as neighboring dogs became more reactive. Handler called dog away, walked outside of building. Outside, dog walked a few feet, then began resisting on leash, pulling back. Handler applied light leash pressure and coaxed dog up to kennel. Dog thrashed back once, then stood and stared at handler. Second handler in area opened gate wide, first handler walked into kennel, able to coax dog in. Handler used straight-arm to keep leash short while stepping out, then removed leash via clip lead.
6/27/2026
Assisted Animal Care with returning dog to inside portion of kennel due to reactivity towards neighboring dogs. Handler arrived, Animal Care was standing outside of building with dog, dog was pacing with head low and tail tucked. Handler took hold of leash, clip leash already attached, able to walk dog through building, no reaction to kenneled dogs, returned to kennel with no issues, used clip leash.
6/24/2026
dog was laying in a crate when i approached, slow lip licking, low growling, baring teeth. I used a catchpole to secure the dog and walk it to the truck. used catchpole to lift dog into truck safely.
6/24/2026
used pet taxi to kennel, tail tucked, wont' take treats but did begin allowing petting and leashing.

7/16/2026
Closed outside for AM cleaning. Dog was demand barking at kennel door, settled once handler fully approached, wiggly body and wagging tail, front paws on door, took treats. Easy to leash, hard pull to yard but able to direct when needed, showed no interest in kenneled dogs. Affiliative with handler, forceful when jumping on lap, soft body and wagging tail, open mouth pant, tongue lolled, eyes soft and closing, allowed petting all over. While exploring yard dog returned to handler frequently soliciting more attention, leaned into handler, allowed more pets, took treats gently. Followed handler to gate, able to pick up leash, hard pull back to kennel, hesitant to enter, able to guide in with gentle leash pressure, tried pushing out as handler removed leash by hand.
*Potential adopters should be counseled on slow introductions and proper decompression time to allow dog to adjust to new home.
7/15/2026
Dog was closed inside for cleaning, at front of kennel, soft face, wagging tail, brief demand bark. Accepted treats through gate. Easy to leash. Exited quickly, no attempts to engage with neighboring dogs. Once outside, dog shook off, walked with strong pull, tail wagging. Needed some direction on leash but no issues directing to main play yard. Dog explored surroundings, tail wagging. Came to handler when called, allowed all petting, leaned in for it. Accepted treats. Easily distracted. Appeared interested in people and dogs outside of yard and would stand still, watching. Broke focus when called by handler. Strong pull on return. Appeared to become nervous while passing reactive neighbors and began panting, turning to look at handler several times, face soft but brow furrowed. Would not enter kennel, no interest in treat trail. Handler opened divider, dog walked in. Handler closed gate, removed leash via clip lead.
7/13/2026
Dog would start to low growl while having head lowered, ears pinned back & flagged tail.  Offered treats, would slowly raise head to take treats while keeping tail flagged & ears pinned then lowered head after eating treats while slowly walking backwards.  Requesting a full evaluation.
